newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli bulldozers move towards Jerusalem hilltop.
newsitem.headline: Israeli bulldozers move towards Jerusalem hilltop.

text.p: Israeli bulldozers moved towards the site of a planned Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem on Tuesday as Israel prepared for a violent Palestinian backlash, witnesses said.

Israeli soldiers ringed Jabal Abu Ghneim, a pine-covered hill called Har Homa by Israel, and Jerusalem police went on high alert. Israel plans to build 6,500 homes for Jews at the site over Palestinian objections.
Trucks carried four bulldozers to the site from a staging point two kilometres (one mile) away. But it was not clear if they would start breaking ground immediately.
The police-escorted convoy included vehicles carrying surveyors who Israeli officials said would begin taking measurements for the housing project.
Public Security Minister Avigdor Kahalani warned the Palestinian Authority not to resort to violence over what it views as a violation of the Israel-PLO peace deals.
"If it lets trigger-happy people act...it will simply be making a very grave mistake. We are prepared for any flareup. Our reaction will be sharp, severe and strong," Kahalani told reporters.
